name: Bilibili Media Workspace
author: OmniDesk
description: Bilibili 推荐/动态/追番/直播/搜索媒体源、yt-dlp/playurl 真实流解析、扫码鉴权与弹幕/双语字幕联动。

config_schema.label: Bilibili Cookie (SESSDATA 等)
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault; never logged or written to plain config.

config_schema.label: 默认首选清晰度
config_schema.description: Preferred stream quality; returns quality_unavailable when requested tier (e.g. 4K/VIP) is unavailable.

config_schema.label: Bilibili API Base URL
config_schema.description: Official Bilibili API base URL (only bilibili.com/b23.tv or explicit loopback test endpoint allowed).

config_schema.label: yt-dlp 可执行文件路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to yt-dlp for stream resolution.

config_schema.label: 代理地址（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional explicit HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy URL; when empty, HTTP(S)_PROXY / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY environment variables are honored for WAN requests while loopback API bases stay direct.

config_schema.label: 网络请求超时（秒）
config_schema.description: Finite HTTP and subprocess timeout in seconds.

config_schema.label: 有限重试次数
config_schema.description: Bounded retry count for transient HTTP failures.
